$comment: W3-10 recorded call (W3-09's format, extended): `routes` also holds field-api's recorded answers to apply_correction and file_report, in order; `filing` lists every file_report request the call makes (the reporter's verbatim last words, the read-back's revision, and field-api's answer, §19 Q119), which field-api's Deno test replays through the confirm grammar and voice_file_report (`setDraftRev` moves the stored draft first, as a photo's re-extraction would); `corrections` are the words apply_correction sends. The worker's PGlite test (apps/worker/src/jobs/voice-filing.pglite.test.ts) checks the live pipeline answers what `routes` records (ids aside) and files once; the agent's pytest (tests/test_filing.py) replays the call on FakeFieldApi.
